raw_text: Patients at AIIMS Delhi are facing severe hardships as the ransomware attack enters its second day. Long queues have formed at manual registration counters, with waiting times exceeding four hours for OPD appointments. Emergency cases are being diverted to Safdarjung Hospital and RML. A cancer patient from Bihar told Times of India that his chemotherapy records are inaccessible and doctors cannot verify his previous dosages. The hospital administration has deployed additional staff but acknowledged that manual processes cannot match the digital system's throughput of 15,000 daily registrations.
